meta_042.purpose: Investigate root causes of zero-variance features identified by meta_041
meta_042.bb_position_issue: BB_UPPER missing from stored indicators — TechnicalIndicatorGenerator only stores BB_LOWER, BB_MIDDLE. BB_UPPER is 0.0 for all 100 rows, causing degenerate BB_RANGE = 0 - positive → negative. Formula (close-bb_lower)/bb_range when bb_range<0 defaults to 0.5 but 1 case in 100 has a special fallback (range=1.0 from else clause), causing extreme outlier 150.25.

root_causes.price_regime: computed as close/predicted_price - 1; with predicted_price stored as exit price in synthetic data (seed_synthetic_outcomes), close/predicted_price ≈ 1.0 for all rows, resulting in 0.0
root_causes.hold_expected: hardcoded avg_hold=60 everywhere in _build_feature_vector; actual hold_minutes are stored in Outcome but not used
root_causes.action_BUY: all 6458 signals are BUY only; no SHORT signals in dataset

meta_042.bb_upper_missing: BB_UPPER storage confirmed absent — all 100 rows store 0.0 for BB_UPPER, BB_RANGE becomes negative (bb_u - bb_l where bb_u=0), condition bb_u != bb_l catches this but bb_range is still negative, raw computation yields extreme value when bb_range is used instead of fallback
dropped_features: price_regime [5]: zero variance — use prediction confidence instead (already [0])
hold_expected [6]: hardcoded constant 0.0417 — available only at trade close, not at signal time
action_BUY [7]: all BUY constant — use prediction confidence instead (already [0])
meta_042.bb_fix: BB_POSITION recomputed using BB_MIDDLE as the reference band center instead of degenerate BB_UPPER/BB_LOWER range. Formula: position relative to BB_MIDDLE band: (close - BB_MIDDLE) / band_width, clamped to [0, 1] where 0.5 = at middle band.
meta_042.next: meta_043 — Implement filtered 6-feature retrain; document required changes to _build_feature_vector in retrain.py (BB fix + zero-var removal)
